answers.label: Head
answers.desc: anterior anatomical region in many animals, which tends to contain sensory and nervous organs and orifices for ingestion and breathing

answers.label: Face
answers.desc: part of the body at the front of the head

answers.label: Eye
answers.desc: organ that detects light and converts it into electro-chemical impulses in neurons

answers.label: Eyebrow
answers.desc: arch of hair above the eye of a human

answers.label: Eyelid
answers.desc: thin fold of skin that covers and protects a human or animal eye

answers.label: Ear
answers.desc: organ that detects sound; organ of hearing and balance

answers.label: Earlobe
answers.desc: lower portion of the outer ear, composed of tough areolar and adipose connective tissues, lacking the firmness and elasticity of the rest of the auricle

answers.label: Nose
answers.desc: organ that smells and facilitates breathing

answers.label: Nostril
answers.desc: one of the two channels of the nose

answers.label: Mouth
answers.desc: body cavity and the parts surrounding it

answers.label: Lip
answers.desc: visible body part at the mouth

answers.label: Tongue
answers.desc: mobile organ located inside the mouth

answers.label: Scalp
answers.desc: anatomical area bordered by the face anteriorly and the neck to the sides and posteriorly

answers.label: Hair
answers.desc: protein filament that grows from follicles found in the dermis, or skin

answers.label: Neck
answers.desc: part of the body, on many terrestrial or secondarily aquatic vertebrates, that distinguishes the head from the torso or trunk

answers.label: Throat
answers.desc: anterior part of the neck, in front of the vertebra

answers.label: Shoulder
answers.desc: part of the body; movable joint between arm and upper body

answers.label: Arm
answers.desc: forearm and upper arm together without hand and shoulder

answers.label: Upper arm
answers.desc: proximal part of the free upper limb between the shoulder and the elbow

answers.label: Armpit
answers.desc: area of the body beneath the joint between arm and torso

answers.label: Elbow
answers.desc: area between the humerus in the upper arm and the radius and ulna in the forearm

answers.label: Forearm
answers.desc: region of the upper limb between the elbow and the wrist

answers.label: Wrist
answers.desc: part of the arm between the lower arm and the hand

answers.label: Hand
answers.desc: extremity at the end of an arm or forelimb

answers.label: Palm
answers.desc: central region of the front (ventral side) of the human hand or other primate hand

answers.label: Finger
answers.desc: one of usually five articulated digits at the end of the tetrapod hand

answers.label: Index finger
answers.src: c c w w w w

answers.label: Middle finger
answers.desc: third finger of the human hand

answers.label: Little finger
answers.desc: smallest finger of the human hand

answers.label: Rib
answers.desc: long curved bone surrounding the chest

answers.label: Abdomen
answers.desc: in vertebrates, region of the body between the thorax at the top and the pelvis at the bottom; in insects, segment at the caudal end of the body, following on from the head and thorax

answers.label: Navel
answers.desc: scar on the abdomen at the attachment site of the umbilical cord

answers.label: Groin
answers.desc: the two creases at the junction of the torso with the thighs, on either side of the pubic area

answers.label: Leg
answers.desc: weight bearing and locomotive anatomical structure of animals

answers.label: Thigh
answers.desc: area between the pelvis and the knee; upper leg

answers.label: Ankle
answers.desc: region where the foot and the leg meet

answers.label: Heel
answers.desc: part of the foot in the back

answers.label: Foot
answers.desc: weight-bearing anatomical structure found in vertebrates

answers.label: Skin
answers.desc: soft outer covering organ of vertebrates

answers.label: Brain
answers.desc: organ that serves as the center of the nervous system in all vertebrate and most invertebrate animals

answers.label: Heart
answers.desc: inner organ for the circulation of blood

answers.label: Lung
answers.desc: essential respiration organ in many air-breathing animals

answers.label: Kidney
answers.desc: internal organ of the excretory system in all vertebrates

answers.label: Intestine
answers.desc: alimentary canal of an animal through which food passes after having passed all stomachs

answers.label: Skull
answers.desc: bony or cartilaginous structure that forms the skeleton of head in vertebrates

answers.label: Bone
answers.desc: rigid organ that constitutes part of the endoskeleton of vertebrates

answers.label: Vein
answers.desc: blood vessel that carry deoxygenated blood towards the heart, with the exception of the pulmonary vein

answers.label: Artery
answers.desc: blood vessel that carries oxygenated blood away from the heart to other organs rather than lungs

answers.label: Nerve
answers.desc: enclosed, cable-like bundle of axons in the peripheral nervous system

answers.label: Blood
answers.desc: organic fluid which transports nutrients throughout the organism

answers.label: Moustache
answers.desc: facial hair grown on the upper lip

answers.label: Beard
answers.desc: facial hair on the chin, upper lip, cheeks and neck

answers.label: Torso
answers.desc: central part of the living body

answers.label: Achilles tendon
answers.desc: tendon at the back of the lower leg

answers.label: Retina
answers.desc: light-sensitive tissue layer inside the eye

answers.label: Eardrum
answers.desc: membrane separating the external ear from the middle ear

answers.label: Uvula
answers.desc: fleshy appendage that hangs from the back of the palate

answers.label: Tonsil
answers.desc: pair of lymph nodes at the back of the throat

answers.label: Larynx
answers.desc: voice box, an organ in the neck of amphibians, reptiles, and mammals

answers.label: Philtrum
answers.desc: vertical groove in the middle area of the upper lip, common to many mammals, extending in humans from the nasal septum to the tubercle of the upper lip

answers.label: Crown
answers.desc: area of teeth covered by enamel

answers.label: Pelvis
answers.desc: lower part of the trunk of the human body between the abdomen and the thighs (sometimes also called pelvic region of the trunk

answers.label: Cuticle
answers.desc: various biological tissues or structures that are thickened or tough

answers.label: Lunula
answers.desc: crescent-shaped whitish bed of a fingernail or toenail
